verdict.rationale: Clerk documents custom Roles and 'fine-grained Permissions' scoped to Organizations, and lets eve tool calls be gated against those permissions and scopes. That goes somewhat beyond the default admin/member roles, but it remains role-attached permission checking within an org context. Nothing in the evidence shows per-resource, relationship-based (ReBAC) or policy/attribute-based (ABAC) authorization, and a community user reports roles are tied to organizations with no global roles. Missing for 10: resource-level permission checks on individual objects, a relationship- or policy-based authorization model, a policy language or engine, and independent corroboration.
